# Happy AI Path, llms.txt

> Jim Perry is a Columbus, Ohio-based AI coach, corporate trainer, and
> Lecturer who teaches AI at The Ohio State University Fisher
> College of Business. He founded Happy AI Path to help executives and
> teams build AI Fluency and confidently adopt AI in the workplace.
> He has trained 1,000+ professionals and brings 20+ years of Fortune 100
> technology leadership to every engagement.

## Services
- [AI Team Training](https://happyaipath.com/services#team-training): Custom, hands-on training built around participant preparation, real workflows, and current business challenges. Most sessions run two to four hours, with longer and multi-session programs available.
- [One-on-One AI Coaching](https://happyaipath.com/services#one-on-one-ai-coaching): Focused support for leaders and professionals working on an AI project, an important workflow, or the use of AI in their own work.
- [Engagements and Pricing](https://happyaipath.com/pricing): Custom AI training and one-on-one coaching engagements start at $5,000. Training includes guided preparation completed by participants before the session, custom content development, and hands-on work with real business challenges.
- [AI Prompting Lab](https://happyaipath.com/prompting-lab): Free library of high-impact prompt templates for executives, strategy, productivity, and team management.

## Credentials
- Based in Columbus, Ohio, serving clients locally and nationally
- Lecturer who teaches AI at The Ohio State University Fisher College of Business
- 20+ years Fortune 100 technology leadership
- Trained 1,000+ professionals in AI adoption and AI Fluency
- Specializes in Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and enterprise AI rollout
